title: Red Dye
summary: Single-use dye recolours compatible equipment red.

fields.Use: Combine with eligible equipment in inventory to recolour it.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Dammon in the Hollow, Last Light Inn and Forge of the Nine.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
